timeline.event: checkout service deployed config_v42, switched EU tax endpoint mapping
tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
rollback started, checkout config reverted to config_v41
errors dropped to baseline, service recovered

root_cause: Checkout config deployment (config_v42) switched EU tax endpoint mapping, causing EU requests to be misrouted to a US endpoint that cannot serve EU tax quotes
why_it_happened: A configuration change (config_v42) was deployed to the checkout service at 09:14, which switched the EU tax endpoint mapping
The misconfigured endpoint mapping caused EU checkout requests to be routed to a US tax endpoint (us-east)
The US tax endpoint cannot serve EU tax quotes, resulting in region mismatch errors and failed tax calculations
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (would affect both EU and US traffic, and gateway was reported healthy)
Database pool exhaustion (presents as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to the last known good version (config_v41)
